text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's not it either...
20... feet...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Wait a sec...
What's happened to me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gran Alegria, who always measures things in miles, is so exhausted she got her units mixed up! Looks like I need to adjust her schedule.
